failed_apply_checkpoints.name: card-backfill-uc-171-apply-30466358220
failed_apply_checkpoints.ruling: The corrected UC-171 apply authorization passed. The workflow then failed closed before extraction because a fresh GitHub artifact download produced transport-ZIP bytes whose SHA-256 differed from the upload-time artifact digest. No packet materialization, permanent commit, gate, publication, or canonical mutation occurred.

repair_boundary: The GitHub artifact ID, workflow run, head SHA, upload-time artifact digest, and all twenty-three internal packet file hashes remain fixed. Downloaded ZIP transport bytes are recorded but not treated as immutable because GitHub may regenerate the archive container. The repair verifies the exact internal manifest, checksum ledger, source bytes, candidate, crop, and every SHA256SUMS row before materialization.
